heading: dayeon Privacy Policy
paragraphs: Your privacy matters greatly to dayeon. This Privacy Policy ("Policy") explains how dayeon collects, uses, discloses, and retains your information when you visit or use our website, marketplace stores, social media platforms, or other services (collectively, "Services"). It also describes how we use personal information for customer service, order processing, marketing, and advertising. By using our Services or providing personal information to dayeon, you are deemed to consent to the collection, use, disclosure, and retention of personal information under this Policy and applicable law.

heading: When is personal information processed?
list: Consent – when you provide consent for specific purposes such as marketing communications or promotional participation.
Contract – processing orders you purchase from dayeon, handling transactions, and delivering products.
Legitimate interests – order management, customer service, improving products and services, and fraud prevention.
Legal obligation – compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

heading: Account information
paragraphs: When you create an account or subscribe to a newsletter, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, gender, date of birth, password or login credentials, shipping address, billing address, and other information.

heading: Purchase information
paragraphs: When you buy products, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, payment information, shipping and billing addresses, order details, purchase history, customer service communications, and marketing preferences.

heading: Online activity information
paragraphs: When you visit our website, we may collect IP address, device type, browser information, pages visited, time on page, navigation paths, and click activity through cookies or similar technologies.

heading: Marketing information
paragraphs: For promotions, surveys, giveaways, affiliate programs, or newsletter subscriptions, we may collect your name, email, phone number, date of birth, social media accounts (if applicable), marketing preferences, and other voluntarily provided information.

heading: Information from third-party partners
paragraphs: We may receive certain information about you from trusted third-party partners to operate our Services and fulfill orders.
list: Marketing and advertising partners may collect email addresses via cookies and pixels and combine them with other data to provide relevant offers.
When you order through third-party platforms, we may receive your name, contact details, shipping address, and transaction history.
For example, when purchasing via Shopee, TikTok Shop, Facebook, or Instagram, the platform may send your name, contact information, and transaction data (excluding full payment card details).
We may request additional information when required for contractual or legal purposes.

heading: Advertising and cookie policy
paragraphs: dayeon uses cookies, pixels, and similar technologies to improve user experience and marketing effectiveness.
You can manage cookies through your browser settings; disabling cookies may affect some website features.
list: Essential cookies – enable core functions such as login, cart, and checkout.
Analytics cookies – help us understand site usage and improve performance.
Advertising cookies – Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google Ads, and TikTok Ads measure campaigns and deliver personalized ads.

heading: Marketplace data processing
paragraphs: dayeon sells products through third-party platforms including Shopee, TikTok Shop, and other authorized marketplaces.
When you order through these platforms, we may receive your name, contact details, shipping address, and order information to process your order.
Payments on marketplace platforms are processed by the platform or its payment provider. dayeon does not store full payment card details for those transactions.
We recommend reviewing each marketplace platform's privacy policy.

heading: Data retention
paragraphs: We retain personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes stated in this Policy, including legal and regulatory requirements.

heading: Information security
paragraphs: dayeon implements appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect personal data from unauthorized access, misuse, or loss.

heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict processing of your personal data and to withdraw consent for marketing communications.
